sample_unit_predictions: sample predictions from a unit language model given a list of sentences using beam search
sample_top_hypotheses: sample top hypotheses from a unit language model for a list of input sentences
encode_units: encode a unit string into tokens using the source dictionary of the task
load_pretrained_sampler: load a pretrained unit language model sampler from a model checkpoint file and data path
post_process_predictions: post process model predictions by stripping padding and applying BPE removal to hypothesis tokens
